highlights: Security handled by ALSOK Co., Ltd.
Dedicated guard patrolling perimeter at all times
About 50 CCTV cameras installed inside and surrounding areas
Regular evacuation drills for fire, earthquake, and suspicious persons
Regular first-aid training for all teachers
Air pollution monitoring (halts outdoor play if PM2.5 >= 50 or AQI >= 100)
School buses equipped with GPS, interior cameras, and body-detection sensors
safety.policy_summary: The school implements comprehensive security measures managed by ALSOK, including gated perimeter security, continuous CCTV monitoring, regular evacuation and emergency drills, staff first-aid training, rigorous air quality monitoring for PM2.5 and AQI, and strict transport safety protocols featuring vehicle body-detection sensors and GPS tracking.
